references.text: The similarity between God's word and rain that brings growth emphasizes how God's word accomplishes what it was sent to do.
The sower's tears turn to joy when the seed bears fruit, just as God's word bears fruit in people's lives.
The image of God's word as seed falling on different types of soil and how it grows reflects how human hearts respond differently to God's word.
The sower who plants seeds without knowing how they grow illustrates how God's word works independently of human understanding.
God's word is living and powerful, able to judge thoughts and attitudes, like a seed that sprouts and grows.
